column1: # The count words a typed line reads as a Menge (job 104): up front ("zwei Gurken", "two apples",
# "drei Liter Milch") and as a bare count at the end after a known name ("Gurken zwei"). The
# article forms ein, eine, einen and einer count only up front: "Trag Milch ein" is no Milch x1.
# A line that starts with a name in the `name` rows keeps its number word ("Drei Glocken
# Spaghetti", "Seven Up"). The `unit` rows are the units an amount can have („zwei Liter Milch“,
# „ein Kopf Salat“, „Hack 500 g“), in public.item_units()'s order. public.item_number_words(),
# public.item_number_names() and public.item_units() on the server and
# app/lib/list/number_words.dart in the app hold this table; app/test/list/entry_test.dart and
# supabase/functions/_shared/number_words_integration_test.ts fail when either drifts from it.
# Tab-separated, lowercase. kind is `count` (text, value, lang), `name` or `unit` (text only).
